adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts, the refreshOAuthTokens function wraps the original token refresh call. When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response object (from the credential sync endpoint) instead of the HubspotToken object that the original hubspotClient.oauth.tokensApi.createToken returns. The code at line 191 then tries to access hubspotRefreshToken.expiresIn and set hubspotRefreshToken.expiryDate, but a Response object doesn't have these properties. This would result in undefined/NaN values being stored, causing authentication failures. The finding correctly identifies this type mismatch bug.
